---
title: "Tidy_Cycle"
output: html_document
---

```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)


source("util/helpers.R")
```

```{r data_load}
cycle_data <- load_data("cycle")
```

```{r clean_data_structure}
 cycle_data <- sanitize_data_structure(cycle_data)
```

```{r}
naniar::miss_var_summary(cycle_data)
```
```{r remove_missing_values}
cycle_data <- cycle_data %>% filter(!is.na(end))
```

```{r remove_duplicates}
cycle_data <- cycle_data %>% distinct(start, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r calc_local_time}
cycle_data <- cycle_data %>%
  mutate(
    start_local = apply_timezone_offset(start, timezone_offset),
    end_local   = apply_timezone_offset(end, timezone_offset)
  )
```

```{r }
cycle_data <- cycle_data %>%
  mutate(
    score.calories = kj_to_calorie(score.kilojoule)
  )
```

```{r select_only_relevant_columns}
cycle_data_cleaned <- cycle_data %>%
  select(id, start_local, end_local,
         score.strain, score.average_heart_rate, score.max_heart_rate,
         score.strain, score.calories)
```

```{r store_clean_data}
write_rds(cycle_data_cleaned, file = here("data", "cleaned_cycle_data.rds"))
```
